Case note: CC/960/2022
Client: Debashish Pawar (railway employee, Jaipur)
Opposing party: M/s Fernandes Constructions
Court: Jaipur District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
Filed on: 5 April 2022
Claim amount: ₹9,10,00,000
Issue: consumer complaint. The builder never obtained the occupancy certificate.
Advice given: Seek a full refund with interest because the builder failed to obtain the occupancy certificate.
Outcome: A full refund with interest was ordered.
Recommended next step: Track the refund instalments.
Witness: Naveen Karve
